title: The 8 Best Beginner Wood Lathe 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for beginner wood lathe 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at beginner wood lathe 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: NOVA 46300 Comet II Variable Speed Mini Lathe 12-Inch x 16 1/2-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Variable speed 250-4,000 RPM, 16-inch swing, 18-inch between centers.
strengths: Variable speed with electronic control maintains consistent RPM under cutting load
16-inch swing accommodates most bowl-turning project sizes
NOVA's headstock quality and spindle runout are better than most competitors at this price
Headstock indexing for fluting and decorative cuts
limitations: 18-inch between centers limits spindle turning to shorter projects
Higher price than basic midi lathes
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: WEN 3421 3.2-Amp 8-Inch by 12-Inch Variable Speed Mini Benchtop Wood Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch swing, 12-inch between centers, Variable speed 580-3,700 RPM.
strengths: Lowest price in the variable-speed lathe category
8-inch swing and 12-inch between centers covers small spindle work and pens
Variable speed across a useful range for small turning
WEN warranty and customer support are good for the price tier
limitations: 8-inch swing too small for bowl turning beyond 6 inches
Motor can bog under aggressive cuts in dense hardwood
features: Tool rest and drive centers included
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: JET 12-Inch x 21-Inch Variable-Speed Woodworking Lathe, 1 HP, 115V 1Ph (JWL-1221VS)
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch swing, 21-inch between centers, 60-3,600 RPM variable speed.
strengths: 21-inch between centers handles most furniture spindle turning
60 RPM minimum enables very large, unbalanced bowl blanks to be turned safely at low speed
Reversible headstock for sanding off the lathe at low speed -- common technique
JET quality control and customer service are reliable
limitations: 12-inch swing is less than NOVA Comet II at a similar price
Heavy -- difficult to move once set up

products.name: Powermatic 20-Inch x 35-Inch Variable Speed Woodworking Lathe, 2 HP, 220V 1Ph (3520C)
products.blurb: Key specs: 20-inch swing, 35-inch between centers, 2 HP motor.
strengths: 20-inch swing handles large bowl blanks and platters
35-inch between centers for furniture legs and full staircase balusters
2 HP motor runs without hesitation under the most aggressive bowl-turning cuts
Powermatic is the American shop lathe benchmark -- built to run daily in production
limitations: Full-size lathe requires significant floor space

products.name: RIKON 70-100 12-by-16-Inch Mini Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch swing, 16-inch between centers, 5-speed pulley.
strengths: 12-inch swing covers most small bowl and spindle turning for beginners
16-inch between centers for pens, lidded boxes, and short spindle work
RIKON builds this lathe with better runout tolerance than most similarly priced minis
Complete tool rest and centers included -- ready to turn after assembly
limitations: 5-speed pulley requires stopping and manually moving the belt to change speed
Smaller motor than variable-speed midi lathes
features: Tool rest and drive centers included

products.name: Delta Industrial 46-460 12-1/2-Inch Variable-Speed MIDI Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-1/2-inch swing, 16-1/2-inch between centers, Variable speed 250-4,000 RPM.
strengths: 12.5-inch swing handles most hobby-scale bowl and spindle turning
Variable speed 250 RPM low end safe for rough, unbalanced bowl blanks
Delta banjo locking system is the most secure tool rest lock in the midi lathe category
Established brand with US service and parts
limitations: 16.5-inch between centers is shorter than JET's 21 inches at a similar price
Heavier than some competitors in the midi category

products.name: Grizzly Industrial T25920 12-Inch x 18-Inch Variable-Speed Benchtop Wood Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 12-inch swing, 18-inch between centers, Variable speed 300-3,700 RPM.
strengths: Variable speed digital readout for precise, repeatable speed settings
Heavy-duty cast-iron construction provides stability during aggressive cuts
Grizzly value pricing is the best per-feature in the midi lathe market
Compact 8-inch x 30-inch footprint fits smaller workbenches
limitations: Grizzly QC variability -- inspect carefully on delivery
3/4 HP motor is modest compared to JET or NOVA at similar price
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: SHOP FOX W1704 1/3-Horsepower Benchtop Lathe
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch swing, 13-inch between centers, 5-speed pulley.
strengths: Small footprint fits on a workbench corner -- no dedicated lathe stand required
13-inch between centers handles pens, bottle stoppers, and small spindles
5-speed covers the range needed for pen turning and small spindle work
Affordable entry point for pen turners specifically
limitations: 1/3 HP motor is the weakest in the category -- bogs in dense hardwood
5-speed pulley system requires stopping to change speed

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
